summary: Blocking poll loop: while the flag at this+0x0 is non-zero, calls sub_563410(this) to process the object, then assigns the return value of SleepWrapper(0xA) (a 10 ms sleep) as the loop update. Returns the last SleepWrapper result.

operations.description: Iterate while the active flag at this+0x0 is non-zero; each iteration runs the body then sleeps.
Call sub_563410(this) to perform per-iteration processing on the object.
Call SleepWrapper(0xA) (10 ms) as the loop update action and assign its return value to result.
Return the last SleepWrapper result after the flag clears.

unresolved: Identity of the object and of the flag at this+0x0; it is likely an active/running state, but who clears it is not visible here.
What sub_563410 actually processes is not recoverable from this function alone.
If the flag is false on entry the loop body never runs and the returned result is uninitialized.
